title: Deficiency Board
description: Track remediation and assess severity using the Degree of Deficiency (DoD) model.

form.title: Remediation Action Plan
form.description: Form for planning and tracking control remediation as per SK-5/2024.

placeholders.remediatedControlDescription: How will the control look after remediation?

wizard.title: Degree of Deficiency (DoD) Assessment
wizard.description: Evaluate deficiency severity based on materiality indicators and regulatory logic flow.
wizard.aggregateDescription: Evaluate combined impact of selected deficiencies as per Box 7 mandate.

step0.title: Automatic Material Weakness Indicators
step0.description: Evaluate based on Material Weakness indicators as per Chapter VII Point 1.1.c (Page 62).
step0.seniorManagementFraud: Indication of fraud involving senior management, whether material or not.
step0.materialFraudImpact: Indication of fraud that results in a material misstatement to the financial statements.
step0.restatement: Restatement of previously issued financial statements to reflect the correction of a material misstatement.
step0.auditorIdentified: Material misstatement identified by external auditors that was not prevented or detected by internal control.
step0.auditCommittee: Ineffective oversight by the Audit Committee over financial reporting and internal control.

box1.title: Box a
box1.question: a. does the control deficiency relate directly to the achievement of one or more financial statement assertions?

box2.title: Box b
box2.question: b. Is there a reasonable possibility (likelihood) that a misstatement could result from the deficiency (or combination of deficiencies)? [AS2201.64-65]

box3.title: Box c
box3.question: c. Is there a reasonable possibility that the magnitude of the potential misstatement (considering material factors for financial statements) could be material? [AS2201.66-67]
box3.materialWarning: Attention: Exposure is ABOVE PM threshold.

box4.title: Box d
box4.question: d. Is the deficiency (or combination of deficiencies) important enough to merit the attention of those responsible for oversight of the company's financial reporting? [AS2201 A11]

box5.title: Box e
box5.question: e. Are there other effective compensating controls that would operate at a level of precision that would prevent or detect a material misstatement on a timely basis? [AS2201.68]

box6.title: Box f
box6.question: f. Would a prudent official conclude that the deficiency (or combination of deficiencies) is a material weakness? [AS2201.18, 70]

box7.title: Box g
box7.question: g. Are there multiple control deficiencies and/or significant deficiencies that affect the same account balance or disclosure? [AS 2201.65]

result.title: Assessment Conclusion
result.autoRationale: Automatic Material Weakness due to identified high-risk indicators (Fraud/Restatement/Audit Oversight).
result.flowchartRationale: Severity determined based on systematic Figure 5 flowchart evaluation of magnitude, likelihood, and compensating controls.
result.rationalePlaceholder: Explain the reasoning for this severity conclusion...
result.mwNote: Material Weakness requires reporting to Audit Committee and Board of Commissioners (Table 24).
result.cdNote: Control Deficiency requires remediation monitoring by Process Owner.
